name: Mad Chihuahua🐕
desc:
🐕 Welcome to Mad Chihuahua! 🐕

⭐ HOW TO PLAY

Buy Chihuahuas 🐕
Chihuahuas drop Bones over time 🦴
Deposit Bones to earn Cash 💰
Use Cash to buy more Chihuahuas 💵
Merge Chihuahuas to unlock higher-tier Chihuahuas 🔧
Chihuahuas sniff out Lucky Boxes over time 🎁
Open Lucky Boxes to get extra Chihuahuas 🐕
Unlock all 18 Chihuahuas and complete your Index! ⭐

🐾 YOUR PACK

Your Chihuahuas follow you around as pets 🐾
Make them do tricks: Sit, Belly Up, Bang! and more 🐶
Snap photos with your pack 📸

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!

llm.loop: buy chihuahuas -> they drop bones over time -> deposit bones for cash -> buy more chihuahuas and merge them into higher tiers -> open lucky boxes -> complete the 18-dog index
llm.objectives: unlock all 18 chihuahuas and complete the index
llm.progression: higher-tier chihuahuas via merging, cash income, pet slots, index completion
llm.instructions: buy chihuahuas, collect bones, deposit for cash, merge for higher tiers, open lucky boxes, unlock all 18
unique: merge tycoon where the pets follow you and can do tricks and pose for photos
monetization_signals: cash multiplier products up to x50
update_signals: asks for likes for more updates
llm.thumbnails: cartoon angry chihuahua icon, packs of voxel chihuahuas on grass, a girl hugging chihuahuas
llm.complexity_notes: small tycoon plot, merge logic, 18 dog models with pet follow and trick animations
